title: Yellow Smoky Sardinian Lamb Lasagna
description: A smoky and indulgent Italian dish featuring lamb, oyster sauce, and double-rise bread, halal-friendly and made in the form of lasagna.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
Cook the lamb mince in a pan with olive oil until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the oyster sauce, tomato sauce, and smoked paprika, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce cook while preparing the bread and cheese.
Tear the double-rise bread into small pieces and toast until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine the toasted bread, mozzarella cheese, and parmesan cheese.

In a 20x30cm baking dish, create a thin layer of the lamb sauce, followed by a layer of the bread and cheese mixture, and repeat this process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
